+func TestStore_BuildManifestVersion(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name            string
+		options         []containers.Option[StoreOptions]
+		artifactType    string
+		configMediaType string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:            "default 1.1",
+			artifactType:    MediaTypeFliptFeatures,
+			configMediaType: "application/vnd.oci.empty.v1+json",
+		},
+		{
+			name:            "explicit 1.1",
+			options:         []containers.Option[StoreOptions]{WithManifestVersion(oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4)},
+			artifactType:    MediaTypeFliptFeatures,
+			configMediaType: "application/vnd.oci.empty.v1+json",
+		},
+		{
+			name:            "explicit 1.0",
+			options:         []containers.Option[StoreOptions]{WithManifestVersion(oras.PackManifestVersion1_0)},
+			configMediaType: MediaTypeFliptFeatures,
+		},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			dir := t.TempDir()
+			ref, err := ParseReference(repo + ":latest")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			store, err := NewStore(zaptest.NewLogger(t), dir, tt.options...)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			src, err := fs.Sub(testdata, "testdata")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			_, err = store.Build(ctx, src, ref)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			layout, err := oci.New(path.Join(dir, repo))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			desc, err := layout.Resolve(ctx, "latest")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			payload, err := content.FetchAll(ctx, layout, desc)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			var manifest v1.Manifest
+			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(payload, &manifest))
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.artifactType, manifest.ArtifactType)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.configMediaType, manifest.Config.MediaType)
+
+			resp, err := store.Fetch(ctx, ref)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Len(t, resp.Files, 2)
+		})
+	}
+}
